attempts.text: {"claims":[{"claim_text":"Concerns for the erosion of the “one country, two systems” framework, losing judicial independence, and losing political and civil rights drove a million protesters to take to the street on June 9, 2019.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Thousands of demonstrators blocked the areas where the government headquarters and legislative council are located when the bill was supposed to be debated in the legislative council.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The police used tear gas, rubber bullets, and bean bags to suppress the unarmed protesters, resulting in at least 80 injuries.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Despite the large-scale protests, the government refused to make any compromises and smeared the occupy actions as riots.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The government decided to pause the legislation temporarily the day before another protest on June 16.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Two million people joined the rally to demand that the extradition bill be completely scrapped and the chief executive step down.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"DSA stands in solidarity with the Hong Kong people, whose actions are legitimate and well-grounded.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"DSA condemns the Hong Kong government for using violence and coercion to suppress the peaceful protesters.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"DSA urges the Hong Kong government to respond positively to the Hong Kong peoples’ demands.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
